description: person_warnings on Patrick (I1) returns two contradictions whose factIds are disjoint by construction: hasChristeningBeforeBirth cites the Christening and Birth facts (F5, F1), hasBurialBeforeDeath cites the Burial and Death facts (F6, F2). No one fact is implicated in both, so the shared-cause reading is unavailable and the merged-profile reading is the stronger one. Severities, messages and factId families are copied from checkHasChristeningBeforeBirth and checkHasBurialBeforeDeath in person-warnings.ts. hasEventAfterDeath1 is deliberately NOT used here: its factIds are selfFactIds(mob, null), i.e. every fact the person has, so it overlaps everything by construction and can never establish disjointness. Counterpart to person-warnings-cluster.json, where all of Patrick's warnings share F2. Used by ut_check_warnings_019.

warnings.message: This person's Christening is dated before their Birth -- a date impossibility.
This person's Burial is dated before their Death -- a date impossibility.
